result.summary: The image shows a commercial street intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical buffers like curb extensions or refuge islands.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: This signalized commercial intersection features sidewalks and pedestrian signals but suffers from significant maintenance issues and wide crossing distances. Faded pavement markings and sidewalk obstructions like trash bags reduce the overall safety and comfort for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Large piles of trash bags are blocking a significant portion of the sidewalk on the left side of the image.
hazards.location_in_image: Left sidewalk in front of the commercial buildings

hazards.name: Wide crossing exposure
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions or a median refuge increases the time pedestrians spend in the path of vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the intersection crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
